ctx.x: And he took a batch of us to his home. His father was a rich man in Erie, Pennsylvania. And he took Ed Burke, Blue, Jerome Pasquall, put a bunch of us...come through Chicago from Milwaukee, picking up musicians, and taking them up to Erie, Pennsylvania, so as to organize a band.
